summary: Iteration 11: Verified Phase 1 Art Studio enhancements - All features working correctly. Art style example images, book assignment dropdown, reference image upload/selection, generate image with download and use as reference buttons all functional.

Book assignment dropdown shows 'General Library' (and would show user's books if they had any)
Art style cards show 10 example images with preview thumbnails (Realistic, Anime, Cartoon, Watercolor, Oil Painting, Pixel Art, Comic Book, Fantasy Art, 3D Render, Pencil Sketch)
Reference Image section appears with Upload Image button
Reference Image section has Use from Gallery button
Gallery picker modal opens when clicking Use from Gallery
Generate Image button works and returns image (tested with character generation)
Download Image button appears after generation
Use as Reference button appears after generation
Save to Gallery button appears after generation
Backend API /api/art-studio/generate works (7/7 pytest tests passed)
Authentication flow works with test user artstudio3@test.com (pro subscription)
critical_code_review_comments: ART_STYLES array in ArtStudio.js includes exampleImage URLs for all 10 styles - properly displaying preview thumbnails
Book assignment dropdown uses selectedBookId state with 'general' as default
Reference image section uses referenceInputRef for upload and setShowGalleryPicker for gallery selection
selectGalleryAsReference function properly renamed (was useGalleryAsReference - fixed React hooks error)
Download uses DOM approach with createElement('a') - works correctly
Use as Reference button calls selectGalleryAsReference(generatedImage) to set the reference

data-testid attributes properly added for testing: book-assignment-select, upload-reference-btn, use-gallery-reference-btn, generate-image-btn, download-image-btn, use-as-reference-btn, save-to-gallery-btn
